long_biography.plain_text:
At Maritime Concept and Construction, Roland Sturm brought designers, engineers and a Chinese shipyard together around a practical brief: making long-distance cruising more fuel efficient. The company developed its explorer designs with naval architect Ron Holland and arranged construction at Cheoy Lee in China.

The design used a single main engine and propeller to reduce fuel consumption, with an independently powered bow thruster for backup propulsion. The design team protected underwater equipment and considered reliability alongside interior accommodation. MCC retained the designs' commercial rights and developed further models, with specialist staff supervising construction. Naval architect Kasia Milewska and project manager Albrecht Buchner worked alongside Holland on the company's projects.
